title: taskWorkspace
responsibility: Provide the selected task worktree path and initial result fields, then record changed paths and a checkpoint commit through the worker's existing ownership guard and worktree adapter.

inputs.name: taskWorkspace.root
inputs.description: Repository working-tree root passed to GitAdapter.

inputs.name: taskWorkspace.task
inputs.description: Stored task. task.claim is optional in the imported type, but this helper requires a claim with a UUID token at runtime; it reads claim.token, repairCommit and sourceCommit.

inputs.name: taskWorkspace.selection
inputs.description: Exact provider, model and intelligence selected for the run.

inputs.name: snapshotTaskWork.root
inputs.description: Repository working-tree root passed to ModuleTaskWorktreeAdapter.

inputs.name: snapshotTaskWork.task
inputs.description: Stored task; task.sourceCommit and task.module.files are passed to the delegated ownership guard.

inputs.name: snapshotTaskWork.result
inputs.description: Existing task result. The helper reads result.sourceCommit and result.worktree, then mutates result.changedFiles and result.checkpointCommit; the imported result field schema is not fully published.

outputs.name: taskWorkspace
outputs.description: Async. Resolves GitAdapter.run(['rev-parse', '--git-common-dir']) and computes the native worktree path with path.resolve(root, commonDirectoryOutput, '..', '.cache/harness/task-worktrees', task.claim.token). It calls pendingTaskResult(selection, worktree), spreads that result into a new object, then sets attempt to the claim UUID token and sourceCommit to task.repairCommit ?? task.sourceCommit. It does not create or remove the worktree, persist the result, or return a cleanup callback.

outputs.name: snapshotTaskWork
outputs.description: Async and mutating. Selects source = result.sourceCommit ?? task.sourceCommit. It assigns result.changedFiles from taskWrites(new GitAdapter(result.worktree), {...task, sourceCommit: source}), then assigns result.checkpointCommit from ModuleTaskWorktreeAdapter.checkpoint({cwd: result.worktree, source, paths: result.changedFiles}). It has no explicit return value and performs no result persistence or worktree cleanup.

errors.name: taskWorkspace missing claim
errors.description: ModuleTask.claim is optional in the stored task contract, but the helper dereferences task.claim.token without a runtime guard. The public caller contract must require a claimed task.

errors.name: Git common-directory lookup
errors.description: GitAdapter.run may throw Error when rev-parse --git-common-dir fails. The exact output formatting of the returned common-directory string is not specified by its public contract.

errors.name: pendingTaskResult construction
errors.description: The public pendingTaskResult contract declares no errors. If its implementation throws, taskWorkspace propagates that rejection, but the dependency error shape is unspecified.

errors.name: taskWrites ownership check
errors.description: taskWrites rejects when worktree HEAD does not match its selected sourceCommit or when tracked changes or non-ignored untracked paths fall outside the exact task.module.files grant. GitAdapter failures also propagate. It leaves the worktree in place and does not stage or commit.

errors.name: checkpoint creation
errors.description: ModuleTaskWorktreeAdapter.checkpoint is declared to return Promise<string> and throw Error; exact checkpoint failure cases are not published.

errors.name: worker once error boundary
errors.description: The worker guards taskWorkspace and snapshotTaskWork after claim. Workspace preparation failures produce a safe nonempty failed result with empty worktree, no provider usage or execution, and finalize the claim; snapshot failures also become failed results.
